scope: Read-only audit of this repository robopianist-rl/run.sh effective baseline, NOT ~/oldproj or paper defaults. Model XML assets are absent in this checkout; morphology-dependent compiled quantities below are not claimed measured.

environment.backend: single CPU MuJoCo composer environment; JAX learner

observation.shape_status: inferred: 979+10+46+88+1+39+1; not compiled due to absent XML
observation.previous_action_units: physical actuator control targets; canonical scaling wraps outside history wrapper
observation.reset_previous_action: BoundedArray.generate_value(): lower bounds in current installed dm_env_wrappers; known inconsistency, do not regress fixed V3.2 neutral reset

action.fingers_tendon_coupling: Source Shadow asset-specific PIP/DIP coupling; absent XML prevents current-checkout compiled verification; cannot copy to TsenseI without explicit morphology adaptation

reward.aggregation: unscaled sum, no multiplication by dt

key_press_reward.formula: 0.5*mean(tolerance(1-q/qmax) for desired keys)+0.5*not(any activated undesired keys); first term 0 on rest

fingering_reward.key_target_world: geom world center + (0.35*geom.size[0],0,0.5*geom.size[2]) for every finger

forearm_reward.geom_scope: root_body.geom of right vs left forearm only

reward.missing_fingering: OT Hungarian matching branch; irrelevant to complete annotated Twinkle baseline

physics.hand_collision_mode: physical same-hand, cross-hand and hand-key contacts; hand-key enabled; original asset exclusions apply
physics.visual_mesh_collisions: visual geoms disabled via asset classes
physics.primitive_fingertips: ShadowHand._build switches plastic_collision mesh ending distal_pst to capsule; other existing primitive/mesh shapes are asset-defined
physics.hand_mass_inertia: retain morphology; not a universal scalar transferable from Shadow

termination_reset.episode_end: after last score frame, no wrong-key termination
termination_reset.replay_order: insert ending transition with terminal observation; then reset and insert(action=None) changes replay previous state only
termination_reset.reset_state: Composer physics reset_context then initialize_episode; original model qpos0 and zero dynamic state, score t=0, no position randomization
v3_2_preserve_fixes: explicit per-world partial reset after storing terminal observation
neutral physical previous_action matching reset ctrl
separate training and evaluation observation variables

sac.critic_loss: mean squared TD error over both Qs and batch
sac.policy_distribution: state-dependent diagonal Gaussian followed by tanh

replay_and_schedule.checkpoint_save: baseline train.py contains no checkpoint serialization

parallel_adaptation.caveat: Collecting a vector of 512 transitions then updating differs from interleaved single-environment collect/update, even when totals and steady ratios match. First mixed vector policy actions use the same pre-update learner.

safe_direct_sync: five original rewards and coefficients; no extra collision reward unless selected
uniform [-1,1] policy mapping to TsenseI physical ranges
physical hand collision bitmask policy plus visual/collision separation
morphology_adaptation_required: Shadow capsule dimensions and placement must be fit to TsenseI geometry, not copied blindly
PIP/DIP tendon coupling and removed thumb joints differ from TsenseI actuation
hand mass/inertia and mounting pose cannot be made numerically identical while preserving TsenseI model
wrist axis/range conventions remain TsenseI; mass-derived damping may reuse rule
forearm-only collision reward requires selecting homologous palm/root geometry if no physical forearm exists
action/observation counts and target entropy scale with retained TsenseI DOFs
do_not_copy_known_issues: Original train.py reuses timestep variable during evaluation and can choose next training action from final eval observation; keep separated GPU implementation
Original history wrapper reset starts at physical lower bound rather than actual neutral control; preserve fixed neutral reset
No checkpoint saving in original train.py does not justify removing current reproducible checkpoint/config pipeline

validation.method: static read of run.sh, dataclasses, task/model source and installed wrapper source; no Shadow training was executed
limits: Expected source Shadow XML directory missing in this checkout
Other agents handle collision asset audit/implementation and root consolidates change logs
